# Firewall reference excerpts

These are transcribed published examples, not live lab captures. Whitespace is normalized and prompts and explanatory arrows are removed.

- `fortinet-route4.txt`: [Fortinet prefix lookup and redistribution example](https://community.fortinet.com/fortigate-3/technical-tip-get-router-info-bgp-network-x-x-x-x-shows-the-output-for-a-prefix-even-if-it-does-not-match-the-route-map-156610).
- `fortinet-multipath4.txt`: [Yuri Slobodyanyuk's FortiGate BGP cookbook](https://yurisk.info/2020/05/20/fortigate-bgp-cookbook-of-example-configuration-and-debug/), May 2020 default-route example.
- `panos-route4.txt`: [Palo Alto Networks gshut example](https://knowledgebase.paloaltonetworks.com/KCSArticleDetail?id=kA14u0000008UfdCAE&lang=en_US), first two-path response.

Command forms come from the FortiOS 7.4.7 CLI Reference, pages 3441–3448 and 3502–3504, and the [PAN-OS 11.1 operational command hierarchy](https://docs.paloaltonetworks.com/ngfw/pan-os-cli-quick-start/cli-command-hierarchy-for-pan-os-111/pan-os-111-cli-ops-command-hierarchy). Tests explicitly synthesize IPv6, VRF and traceroute samples. Live dual-stack and routing-context captures remain pending.
